description: Utilities for interacting with app deployments API, including fetching deployment details, normalizing statuses, and aggregating deployment counts.

methods.name: fetchProjectNameByProjectId
methods.description: Fetches a project name given a project ID, querying the /api/app-deployments endpoint with a filter.

methods.name: fetchDeploymentStatusCounts
methods.description: Fetches deployment status counts, either from server endpoint or via client-side aggregation as fallback.
